title: Datakin: Server Delver, A complete Gameboy Advanced Platformer game
author: sunsparkswift
selftext:
Hello!

TL:DR: I directed Datakin: Server Delver, a complete GBA platformer made with help from Codex, Claude, and Spritefusion. It’s free to download, with a link below. 

This is the first of what I hope will eventually be a series of games which spans several different genres and platforms, both retro and modern. I actually didn’t intend for this one to come out first, this was a side project I started after seeing the post about Astra being able to build a GBA game and after discovering Spritefusion, but even as the scope increased a few times during it, it still is far smaller in scope than my “main” Datakin project and it only took a few months to get it to a state which I’d now call complete (though I may do an update or two based on what feedback I get).

I had Codex and Claude design a level editor, and then designed the levels from start to finish myself in the editor, asking Claude/Codex when I wanted a new feature or hazard, then polished them after testing them, and so on. Music was, uh, hummed by me in Audacity to get the tune and then made into something that’s actually music by Codex and Claude. Quite a few people helped with the art (Steph K, Fergalaz (who made the logo), Jesús Santana Agurto (who did the cover and the title)), Spritefusion was for animating it and translating to pixel art, which was invaluable.

The game itself stars Ket, a “Datakin” whose moves and abilities are decided by a grid the player can collect bytes for and customize, with up to 3 presets that can be swapped during levels. It has 12 levels and 10 of those have hidden areas and mini-bosses, it has quite an assortment of moves, upgrades, and other customizations one can make to their abilities, and the first 10 levels can be played in any order. It takes about 3-5 hours to beat, depending on one’s skill at platformers and if one is getting all the secrets or not. It will play on mGBA and VisualBoyAdvance and on the actual GBA hardware as well (I’ve tested it with GBA SP and on a 3DS).

If you are interested in playing it, the site is: https://circuitfoxes.com/datakin-server-delver which also links to the itch.io page. If anyone who plays it has feedback I’d love to hear it!
